run_write_top_k_vasp_cli: run the write_top_k_vasp script to generate VASP input files for the top k adsorbate-slab configurations from a sorted cache
run_write_top_k_vasp_single_point: run write_top_k_vasp with the --sp flag to generate single point VASP input files instead of relaxations
run_write_top_k_vasp_relaxation: run write_top_k_vasp with --nsw 2000 to generate VASP relaxation input files for top k configs
review_VASP_FLAGS: review the VASP_FLAGS dictionary to understand default VASP calculation parameters like ibrion, encut, and ediffg
summarize_write_vasp_input_files: summarize how write_vasp_input_files generates POSCAR, INCAR, KPOINTS, and POTCAR files from atoms and vasp_flags
